accordion.$description: Accordion (and the Collapsible panel it shares its motion with). Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens.

trigger-padding-block.$description: Block padding of a trigger row. Rides the density cell padding with a fixed 4px of breathing room, so the default row is unchanged (16px, a 52px row for one line of label), compact tightens to 10px (40px), and comfortable stays at the default.

divider.$description: The rule between items. Decorative — the triggers themselves are the structure.

focus-bleed.$description: How far a descendant's focus ring reaches outside its box. An open panel clips its contents to animate height; it clips this much outside its own edges rather than at them, so a control flush with the panel edge keeps its whole ring.

duration.$description: Height transition of a panel opening or closing, and the indicator's turn. Collapses under prefers-reduced-motion through the base layer.
